2609.28026.title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
2609.28026.paper_summary: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.
2609.28026.paper_summary_zh: 我們調查最先進的大型語言模型（LLMs）是否生成反映專家教師在反饋重點和適應性方面的教學實踐的反饋。先前的評估工作已經檢查了反饋特徵、其對學習的影響以及其目標，然而反饋的重點及其適應性仍然在很大程度上被忽視。為了填補這一空白，我們採用並完善了Narciss的分類法，將其劃分為七種類型的反饋重點，以標註三門大學寫作課程中的教師和LLM生成的反饋。我們發布了FeedType，這是一個基準，包含來自六個LLM在三種提示策略下的標註教師和LLM反饋。我們評估了反饋重點類型的覆蓋範圍和分佈，並檢查LLMs是否像專家教師一樣在草稿階段和學生表現水平之間調整其反饋。我們的研究結果顯示，雖然大多數LLMs涵蓋了大多數反饋重點類型，但它們未能反映教師反饋的分佈，並顯示出不同程度的適應性，沒有一個與教師的適應行為相匹配。我們相信FeedType將支持未來在LLM反饋生成中的教學對齊研究。
